project_info.theme: Playful pink-carpet premiere portrait with ginger waves and denim styling
project_info.color_palette: ginger red, black, blue denim, bright pink carpet, silver jewelry and white flash

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with vibrant ginger-red hair in long loose center-parted waves and two small pink butterfly or floral clips at the temples. She has a pale complexion, blue eyes, rosy cheeks and a soft closed-lip playful smile. She wears a black strapless fitted fashion top, blue denim jeans, a black studded belt, a thin silver choker and a small silver floral navel accessory.
main_subject.style: photorealistic professional paparazzi flash portrait with realistic hair, skin and denim texture

composition_elements.layout: vertical waist-up to mid-torso portrait at eye level, slightly off-center with the subject leaning subtly forward
composition_elements.background: bright pink carpet premiere with blurred photographers, camera flashes, event posters and crowd
composition_elements.text: Keep background event signage blurred and non-identifying; no celebrity branding required.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: professional direct flash with high contrast and bright frontal illumination
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: crisp facial detail, subtle natural skin texture, bright premiere energy and heavy background bokeh

technical_specs.optics: 85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, sharp subject focus and strong background bokeh

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic professional flash portrait of a generic clearly adult woman with vibrant ginger-red hair in long loose waves with a center part and two small pink 3D butterfly or floral hair clips at the temples. She has a pale complexion, blue eyes looking slightly to the viewer's right, rosy cheeks and a soft playful closed-lip smile. She wears a black strapless fitted fashion top, blue denim jeans with a black leather belt featuring two rows of silver studs or grommets, a thin silver diamond tennis choker and a small silver floral navel accessory. Frame her from the waist up at eye level, slightly off-center, with a subtle forward lean. Set the scene on a bright pink carpet at a public premiere with blurred paparazzi photographers, camera flashes, event posters and a crowd in the background. Use professional direct flash, high contrast, bright illumination, an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, sharp subject focus, heavy bokeh, detailed hair and fabric texture and vertical 9:16 composition. Preserve the source hair, clips, outfit, jewelry, pink-carpet atmosphere and playful pose without reproducing Sadie Sink or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, readable event logo, distorted background faces
